tail_split.switch: DG_SM90_PREFILL_TAIL_SPLIT=1 with DG_SM90_PREFILL_4STAGE=1; host appends the trailing template argument kPrefillTailSplit=true only then
tail_split.design: Pool blocks with <= 64 valid rows (D5a half tiles) run rows 0..63 on both math warpgroups, warpgroup g taking columns 128g..128g+127 with one m64n128 accumulator from B rows 128g of the same stage. FC1: SwiGLU of 64 gate/up pairs per warpgroup, per-row amax over the 128 output columns exchanged between the partner warps through the staging-slice pads and a 64-thread named barrier (12 + warp), one FP8 scale written by warpgroup 0; FC2: weight-SF block g, BF16 rows written through the per-warp slices in two 64-column steps. Both warpgroups publish the FC1 rows, so the FC2 loader expects 12 x 2 x 4 arrivals for such blocks.
tail_split.why_option_A: Option B (SwapAB tails, tokens on N) would also remove the sub-64-row padding (6.5-7.4 % of rows at EP1) but needs transposed FC1 SwiGLU/SF128 and FC2 scatter epilogues for N = 8..64 and is SMEM-bound for small N; option A reuses the m64n128 split-N descriptors of the four-warpgroup path and the existing epilogue arithmetic.

d5a_half_tile_cost_from_40095847738.method: control-minus-D5a saving divided by 0.5 x half-tile share x GEMM time; GEMM ~85 % of the kernel

compile.untouched: every three-stage, Decode and four-stage (no split) instantiation is SASS-identical to 5176716

tail_split.host_contract: scripts/check-sm90-prefill-local-host.py: 138 configurations; the switch only appends ',true' to the 2WG Prefill template and changes nothing else

expected_saving_us_per_layer_pp4.assumption: half tile h 0.64-0.70 -> split 0.52-0.55 of a full tile on 13.4 % of tiles

tail_split.exactness: Same K order, scales and rounding per element; bit-identical unless the m64n128 and m64n256 WGMMA sums differ, which the in-job gate bounds on every token (relative L2 < 0.002, max scaled error < 0.02 against the control) plus the FP32 reference.
